title: An online rapid screening HPLC system establishing and applying discovered a new type of natural chemical ligand of the BRD4-BD1 from Hedyotis diffusa.
authors: Wang, Lina; Wang, Hong; Chen, Shizhong
journal: Journal of pharmaceutical and biomedical analysis
one_liner_zh: 该文用在线HPLC筛选BRD4-BD1天然配体并辅以分子对接，对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法仅含简单对接，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: Herein, we report an online high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) for screening of the bromodomain-containing protein 4-first bromodomain (BRD4-BD1) ligands, leading to screen a new type of natural chemical ligand of the BRD4-BD1 from Hedyotis diffusa. The system was first established, validated, and then applied for rapid screening the ligands of BRD4-BD1 from Hedyotis diffusa. It was investigated using the positive ligand JQ1 in five aspects including the suitability, the specificity, the reproductivity, the limit of detection (LOD), and the saturability of this system. When it was been applied to screen BRD4-BD1 ligands from Hedyotis diffusa, one candidate ligand 1 was fished out. Then the ligand 1 was isolated and identified. And their interaction between the screened ligand 1 and the BRD4-BD1 was assay on the online system again and followed verified by the surface plasmon resonance (SPR) technique. The molecular docking was performed to the binding mode of ligand 1 with BRD4-BD1. The ligand 1 was found as a new type of natural ligand for BRD4-BD1 protein. In a conclusion, we have systemically demonstrated the feasibility of the online HPLC system screening method applying to screen the chemical ligand of the BRD4-BD1 in complex substance systems. Besides, the ligand 1 provided a potential new type of scaffold for chemical modification for BRD4-BD1 inhibitors in future.
abstract_zh: 在此，我们报道了一种在线高效液相色谱（HPLC）方法，用于筛选含溴结构域蛋白4-第一溴结构域（BRD4-BD1）的配体，并成功从白花蛇舌草（Hedyotis diffusa）中筛选出一种新型天然化学配体。该系统首先建立并验证，随后应用于快速筛选白花蛇舌草中BRD4-BD1的配体。使用阳性配体JQ1从五个方面对该系统进行了考察，包括适用性、特异性、重现性、检测限（LOD）及系统的饱和性。当将其应用于从白花蛇舌草中筛选BRD4-BD1配体时，钓取到一个候选配体1。随后，对配体1进行了分离和鉴定。在在线系统上再次测定了筛选出的配体1与BRD4-BD1之间的相互作用，并通过表面等离子体共振（SPR）技术进行了验证。通过分子对接研究了配体1与BRD4-BD1的结合模式。结果发现，配体1是BRD4-BD1蛋白的一种新型天然配体。总之，我们系统性地证明了在线HPLC系统筛选方法在复杂物质体系中筛选BRD4-BD1化学配体的可行性。此外，配体1为未来BRD4-BD1抑制剂的化学修饰提供了一种潜在的新型骨架。
